Dynamic residential from $2/GB, dynamic datacenter $0.8/GB. Dynamic residential is priced differently at each read: $2/GB (cached FAQ, read 2026-11-03), $5 per GB (archive of 2026-06-16) and $10 / GB (archive of 2026-01-08); all three are dead-site prices.
free_tier.notes: Read from a cached copy through one reader; the origin now answers HTTP 410 on every path.

The registration fields are unverified: the site is unreachable.
